Captain.authority: emergency coordination, promulgation, cross-ministry conflict resolution
Captain.cannot_unilaterally: permanent tax, debt restructuring, independent monetary decision

Central Bank Governor.authority: liquidity, prudential tools, FX backstop within reserve limit
Central Bank Governor.cannot_unilaterally: fiscal guarantee or permanent capital control

Finance & Fiscal Minister.cannot_unilaterally: central-bank liquidity or sector environmental licence
Finance & Fiscal Minister.budget_guardrail: new recurring outlay requires multi-year funding source

Trade & Foreign Economic Minister.cannot_unilaterally: broad capital control or tariff action exceeding delegated band

Industry, Investment & Infrastructure Mi.cannot_unilaterally: environmental waiver or fiscal outlay beyond appropriation

Social Affairs & Internal Stability Mini.authority: employment support, social coverage, minimum-wage proposal

approval_matrix.condition: restriction of trade, FX, or capital >30 days
project land/environment footprint above local threshold

state_gates.government_crisis: only reversible policies and pre-approved contracts may initiate; debt/FX emergency requires two-role approval
state_gates.institutional_collapse: no new discretionary policy; contracts, projects, shocks and automatic stabilizers continue
state_gates.empty_state: no actor can submit new action; only scheduled expiry, settlement, decay and recovery event handlers run
state_gates.recovery: Captain plus two functioning ministries restore permissions gradually; no retroactive effect duplication

validation_rules: idempotency_key unused for same policy/territory/effective window
